items.html: And this second phase, which is the first Hey of HaVaYaH, including the expansion of the Mochin, is called Bina, and it is the Lamed of the Tzelem, and it is light, it is the NHY of the third Tevuna, and it is called Tzelem, since the third phase, called Tzadi, is also included in it; and it is also called Lamed, after the three Yuds in the name Ehyeh in Ima in the filling of Yuds. For the Tzelem, which is the first phase, is called Mem, after the four Yuds of HaVaYaH of AB, since the Mochin themselves were revealed; but here, where the NHY of Tevuna were revealed and the Mochin are hidden, it is therefore called Lamed, after the three Yuds of Ehyeh of Yuds of Ima, as above.
